Scope: separate exploratory BOI optical calculation for the four source-bound reviewed development events; no cohort admission
Source: preserved-input mean over original fixed native-event union footprint; Review.Traces{row}.Raw
SourceForHumanJudgment: saved corrected intensity primary; filtered score supporting; raw/removed trend correction QA

ReferenceRule.ShortReference: use its actual count for this explicitly selected exploratory reference; never relabel it as satisfying the original 20-sample rule
ReferenceRule.ExistingNativeEligibility: preserve separately as context, with both-sign contributors and reviewed contact flags

Formula.SignedFraction: q=(r(a:b)-B)/(B-O), O is the supplied camera offset in original counts
Formula.ExtremumFrames: all recorded frames attaining each exact extremum; no snapping or interpolation
Formula.NegativeValues: retain; no abs, sign clipping, automatic relabeling or choosing the larger magnitude

Guards.PreflightFailure: changed source/hash/revision, malformed or mismatched identity/bounds stops calculation/export
Guards.NonfiniteEvent: unavailable_nonfinite_event_samples; retain a separately valid B but withhold all interval optical summaries
Guards.NumericallyComplete: computed_exploratory; not valid physiology or recognition

Alternatives: one record for every saved discrete onset/recovery combination; no averaged alternatives or invented preferred recovery; unjudged onset gets an unavailable record
RequiredProvenance: native master association and known historical checksum limitation
